scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @orbit/protocol && npm run build --workspace @orbit/server && npm run build --workspace @orbit/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol apps/server && tsc -p bench && npm run typecheck --workspace @orbit/web
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test || (echo "\n  e2e needs Playwright:  npm i -D @playwright/test && npx playwright install chromium\n" && exit 1)
